title: Cancelled Games Now Show Up Struck Through, Not Deleted | vitalii.no
description:
Spond sends two signals our calendar server used to ignore: cancelled:true when the club calls off a game, with a reason, and a per-child declinedIds list when a parent taps 'can't make it'. A Kolbu fixture that had moved to October, and a Thursday training one child had been pulled from, both kept sitting on the family calendar looking like perfectly normal, upcoming events.

The server now tracks which Spond group-member id belongs to which of our children in every group, because Spond answers declines with member ids that differ per group, not one shared profile id. An event only counts as declined when every one of our children in that group has actually declined it; cancelled events, previously skipped over entirely, are now kept and flagged with their own cancellation reason. Both signals travel through the API to the family kiosk, which now renders the event in grey with a strikethrough and a small cancelled marker instead of hiding it.

Two real events that used to look completely untouched — the moved Kolbu fixture and the declined Thursday training — now render correctly instead of blending in with every ordinary upcoming game on the calendar.
